contracts.name: lorethra.common
contracts.notes: Shared identifier, timestamp, and provenance definitions.

contracts.name: lorethra.command-envelope
contracts.notes: Matches the existing validated command envelope; it does not add a new HTTP route.

contracts.name: lorethra.internal-service-result
contracts.notes: Target result envelope for extracted services; existing command and read routes retain their current shapes until migrated.

contracts.name: lorethra.integration-error
contracts.notes: Design contract for the separate integration API; current local API error responses remain unchanged.

contracts.name: lorethra.world-summary
contracts.notes: Allowlisted public view example; does not expose internal world-version JSON or author notes.

contracts.name: lorethra.integration-api
contracts.notes: A bounded world-read example only; authentication grants and endpoint inventory remain for L-23 through L-25.

contracts.name: lorethra.event-envelope
contracts.notes: Envelope only; event catalog, ordering, retries, and delivery behavior are deferred to L-26.

contracts.name: lorethra.scene-snapshot
contracts.notes: Stable envelope only; scene semantics and payload details are refined by L-03 before persistence.

contracts.name: lorethra.asset-reference
contracts.notes: Metadata reference only; bytes and local filesystem paths are not embedded.

contracts.name: lke.context.v1
contracts.notes: Preserves the existing protocol identifier and ContextCompiler manifest shape.
